# Determine the probability that F(x) ^ F(x^0x01000000) == 0
import feal, random
random.seed(1)
cnt=0; N=200000
for _ in range(N):
    x = random.getrandbits(32)
    if feal.f_function(x) ^ feal.f_function(x ^ 0x01000000) == 0:
        cnt+=1
print("prob F(x)^F(x^0x01000000)==0:", cnt/N)

# and probability that F(x) == F(x^0x01000000) ^ D for a *fixed* random D
D = random.getrandbits(32)
cnt=0
for _ in range(N):
    x = random.getrandbits(32)
    if feal.f_function(x) ^ feal.f_function(x ^ 0x01000000) == D:
        cnt+=1
print("prob == fixed random D:", cnt/N)
EOF

import feal, random
random.seed(1)
vals = set()
for _ in range(200000):
    x = random.getrandbits(32)
    vals.add(feal.f_function(x) ^ feal.f_function(x ^ 0x01000000))
print("high byte zero count:", sum(1 for v in vals if (v>>24)==0))
